title: Update on Momentum Trading — real-time tracking, transparent backtests, and bugs I found and fixed
author: Basic-Form-1859

comments.author: willmorris92
comments.body: How are you handling lookahead bias in the backtest?

comments.author: Basic-Form-1859
comments.body: For sp500 and nasdaq100omentum backtests we are using yahoo financial data as our data source, so we are not using future data source, literally there is no lookahead bias. For sp500:fundamental, we are relying on sec 10q and10k filing, the index membership is retrieving from Wikipedia so we are not using current membership to calculate back test. Hope this answers your question
